name: supercompress
description: Query-aware context compression for Grok Bot and coding agents. Compress tool dumps, logs, diffs, and pasted files before they burn tokens — 64% mean context reduction with 24/24 evidence-retention passes on the B5 coding-agent benchmark. Hosted remote MCP (works in Grok Bot cloud).
